skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Spring in Her Lens
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Spring in Her Lens. Clothes Xingzhu wore to her nutritional science course graduation ceremony. With a billowing deep blue robe paired with a lilac Yanese satin jacket, she is ready for the lens to capture her smile.
skins.quote: 'Move over a little, a little bit more... Okay, I'm taking the photo now! Thank you for going out of your way to come to my graduation ceremony. Can I keep this photo? I'd like to use it as a bookmark.'
